dialogs.about: 주말 캠핑을 앞두고 아들과 짐을 챙기며

lines.en: Mom, is the tent in the car?
Grandpa put it in the car this morning.
Good. Where is my fishing rod?
It's next to the bucket by the door.
I need a new hook and a flashlight.
I will buy them at the store tomorrow.
Thank you. Can we make a campfire?
Of course. Let's eat marshmallows by the campfire!
Mosquitoes bit me near the tent last year.
I will put medicine in your sleeping bag.
Hi. Is the fishing good here today?
Yes. I caught three fish this morning.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 세 마리 잡았어요.

lines.en: Wow! May I see them in your bucket?
lines.ko: 와! 양동이에 있는 걸 봐도 될까요?

lines.en: Of course. Please look inside.
My hook is too big for them.
lines.ko: 제 낚싯바늘은 그 애들한테 너무 커요.

lines.en: Take my small hook. I have another rod.
lines.ko: 제 작은 바늘을 쓰세요. 낚싯대도 하나 더 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you so much. You are very kind.
Will you stay here tonight?
Yes. We will sit by the campfire later.
lines.ko: 네. 이따가 모닥불 옆에 앉을 거예요.

lines.en: Bring a flashlight. It's dark near the tent.
